# SparkLab

> SparkLab is an immersive 8-week entrepreneurship program for high school students based in Birmingham, Michigan. Students work in teams to build a real business — researching markets, designing a brand, building financial projections, and pitching to a panel of industry judges for cash prizes (1st place $7,500, 2nd place $5,000, 3rd place $2,500). SparkLab partners with schools across Michigan and the greater Midwest and is a collaborative initiative between SIGU and KMI.

Key facts:
- Program length: 8 weeks
- Format: 42 video modules + facilitation guides + workbooks + final pitch competition
- Audience: high school students (typically grades 9-12)
- Recommended team size: 5 students; typical cohort size: 20-40 students
- Time commitment: 2-3 hours per week, during class time
- Cost: no public pricing; schools contact SparkLab to discuss partnership
- Geographic reach: Michigan, with expansion across the Midwest
- Contact: outreach@sparklabusa.com

## Cities served (Michigan)

- [Birmingham, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/birmingham-mi) — SparkLab's home base in Oakland County
- [Royal Oak, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/royal-oak-mi) — Oakland County
- [Bloomfield Hills, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/bloomfield-hills-mi) — Oakland County
- [Troy, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/troy-mi) — Oakland County
- [Rochester, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/rochester-mi) — Oakland County
- [Detroit, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/detroit-mi) — Wayne County
- [Ann Arbor, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/ann-arbor-mi) — Washtenaw County
- [Grand Rapids, MI](https://sparklabusa.com/schools/grand-rapids-mi) — Kent County (West Michigan)
